children: CNBC host Jim Cramer called CrowdStrike stock a “MUST BUY” on Monday after founder and CEO George Kurtz posted about securing artificial intelligence, according to BeInCrypto, saying defenders must block attacks in real time rather than write policy documents. Kurtz said autonomous AI campaigns now set the pace, pointed to CrowdStrike and Nvidia’s SafeMind launch on Sept. 1, and said the company will bring front-line data to talks on AI frontier pacing. CrowdStrike closed Friday at $206.74 and was up 3.86% in overnight trading at $214.72.

title: Jim Cramer Calls CrowdStrike A MUST BUY On Kurtz AI Security Post
